rows.title: A fresh copy asks for the owner account and shows no demo login
Every data endpoint refuses a visitor who is not logged in
Setup refuses a password shorter than 8 characters and a missing business name
Setup creates the owner, logs them in, and sets a protected cookie
Setup cannot be run a second time
A wrong password and an unknown user get the same answer
Username ignores letter case; password does not
Logging out kills the session on the server, not only in the browser
Eight wrong passwords lock that username; other users can still log in
A made-up or tampered session cookie is refused
The owner's own category list is pre-loaded
Add a second store, then rename it
Duplicate location name (any letter case) and unknown location type are refused
Add a category and a sub-category; adding the same name again does not duplicate it
A third category level is refused; a category with sub-categories cannot be deleted
Add a supplier, a job worker and two customers; an old balance is carried in
A party without a name or with an unknown type is refused
Edit a party
A party with a balance cannot be removed; a settled one can and leaves the list
Add an item with sizes, colours, prices and opening stock; each size gets its own numeric barcode
Add a blazer and a raw material measured in metres
An item with no size row, or opening stock with no location, is refused
Two items cannot share a barcode, and the refused item is not half-saved
Edit prices, add a size, then remove the unused size; stock is untouched
An item with stock cannot be removed; a category in use cannot be deleted
Add an expense for a store; the list filters by date and store
An expense of zero, a negative amount, an unknown payment mode or a badly written date is refused
Purchase: freight is shared into the cost per metre; the supplier balance updates
Walk-in sale: line discount, bill discount, courier charge and round-off to the rupee
A walk-in bill that is not fully paid, or a payment above the total, is refused
Selling more than the stock is refused, leaves no trace, and does not use up a bill number
The same item on two lines cannot together exceed the stock
Zero, negative or non-numeric quantity, negative rate, and discount outside 0–100% are refused
Half a shirt cannot be billed; 2.5 metres of fabric can be bought
Unknown item, location, party or bill type is refused
Impossible dates (30 February, month 13) and future dates are refused
A 100% discount line and a zero-rupee bill are accepted; a bill discount larger than the bill is capped
Credit sale to a customer raises their balance
A payment against a bill shows on the bill and lowers the balance; overpaying the bill is refused
On-account Payment In and Payment Out move the party balance
A payment with no amount, no party or an unknown direction is refused
Sale return against a bill puts stock back and lowers the balance
A return cannot take back more pieces than the bill sold (4 sold, 1 already returned, 4 asked)
A return cannot be made against an item that was not on the bill, or against a cancelled or unknown bill
A sale that has a return against it cannot be cancelled first
Purchase return lowers the stock and what is owed to the supplier
Cancelling a bill returns stock and money, keeps the number, and reports drop it
A purchase whose stock has been used or returned cannot be cancelled
The bill list filters by type, date, store and search text
GST cannot be switched on before a GSTIN is entered
Enter a GSTIN and state, then switch GST on
Garment slab on tax-inclusive prices: 5% up to ₹2,500, 18% above; CGST equals SGST
A customer in another state is charged IGST instead
With prices before tax, GST is added on top
The GST Summary report adds up by rate
Switching GST off hides the GST report and new bills carry no tax
A transfer moves stock from the godown to a store
A transfer is all-or-nothing: one short line stops the whole transfer
A transfer to the same place, of zero pieces, of half a piece, or with no lines is refused
An adjustment removes damaged pieces and appears as a write-off in Profit & Loss
An adjustment of zero, without a reason, or below zero stock is refused
Item history lists every movement, and the movements add up to the stock shown
A cost sheet saved as "in production" takes raw material out and shows as work in progress
Completing with the real piece count and final costs gives the right cost per piece and average cost
A finished cost sheet cannot be completed twice; an empty sheet or one with no pieces is refused
Cancelling an open cost sheet puts the raw material back
A finished cost sheet whose pieces are already sold cannot be cancelled
"Allow billing when stock is short" lets a sale go below zero; switching it off blocks it again
A location that still holds stock cannot be switched off; a switched-off location cannot bill
The owner adds two staff, each tied to a store, and they can log in
A duplicate username (any letter case) and a short password are refused
Staff are refused on every owner-only screen and action
Staff see no profit, no cost value and no other store on the dashboard or in reports
A staff bill is always made from their own store, whatever the request says
Staff list and open only the bills of their own store
Staff cannot cancel someone else's bill; they can cancel their own bill of today
A switched-off user is logged out at once and cannot log in again
A password reset by the owner signs that user out everywhere; the old password stops working
The last active owner cannot be demoted or switched off
The app holds 10 active users; the 11th is refused
SQL-injection text in login, search, dates and names is treated as plain text
Script text and formula text in a name are stored as text and reach Excel as text, not as a formula
Requests that are not JSON are refused, which blocks form posts from other websites
Broken JSON, an over-long field and an oversized upload get a clean error, and the app keeps running
Security headers are set and the server does not advertise what it runs on
Source code, the database and files outside the app are never served
The logo accepts only PNG / JPG / WebP image data; the brand colour accepts only a colour code
An unknown API address gives a JSON "not found", not a web page
Changing or deleting a record that does not exist says "not found" instead of pretending to succeed or crashing
The payment on a walk-in bill cannot be deleted on its own (the bill would be left unpaid); cancel the bill instead
A payment on a credit bill can be deleted by the owner and the balance goes back up
Staff can refund only against a bill: a return with no bill is refused for staff, allowed for the owner
A cost sheet cannot be completed on a date before it was started
A username must be at least 3 characters with no spaces
All 19 reports open for the owner with a title, a period line, columns and rows
Every report downloads as a real Excel file and a real Word file with a sensible file name
The Excel Sales Register holds the same rows and total as the screen, with real dates and numbers
The Word Profit & Loss contains the business name, the title and the net profit figure
A wrong report name, dates the wrong way round, a bad date, an unknown format or filter gets a clear refusal
Every party's statement closes at exactly that party's balance
A statement for part of the period opens with the balance brought forward
QA books: the sales figure is the same in Profit & Loss, Category, Channel, Store, Staff and Sales Register
QA books: Daily Sales net equals the Sales Register bill total; units match too
QA books: Profit & Loss lines add up to net profit; gross profit equals the channel report
QA books: net profit per item in Unit Economics adds back to the business total
QA books: Party Outstanding equals the dashboard and the party list
QA books: Stock Summary equals the Stock screen and the dashboard
